Hollywood remakes don’t exactly have the best reputation… but on rare occasions, a remake comes along that drastically improves on the original movie.

In this video, I’m comparing some of the best movie remakes ever made to the original. These are some of the only remakes better than the original, the ones that critics and audiences embraced, and the few that became classics. Many of these movies are so good, most people don't even know the original exists.

From horror and action to the best crime dramas of all time, these are the flawless movie remakes and cult favorites that prove Hollywood can still get it right.
